# Cedric Stanhope & Harcourt

- [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) — Mentor of — [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) — former instructor to Cedric · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Revelation P2](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0002)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) begins her first day teaching school in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), observing the various pupils in her classroom and forming an immediate warm connection with [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md). After dealing with minor disciplinary issues and feeling exhausted by the day's end, she is visited by an overly eccentric mother, Mrs. Trask, who insists on specific pronunciations and names for her children. Afterwards, [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) gifts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) wild orchids on her walk home, lifting her spirits before she reflects on the day with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md).
>
> — v2 · V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P11](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0011), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020)_

> In a letter to [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) recounts amusing experiences and humorous remarks from her students while teaching school in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley). She shares duplicates of student compositions, including an unexpectedly romantic letter from [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md) that was copied from old love letters, before introducing a letter from her favorite student, [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md).
>
> — v2 · XI Facts and Fancies

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_

> [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) chats with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) during a meal, sharing stories about [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) and [Milty Gammon](../character/milty-gammon.md). Afterwards, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) walk to [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) to visit [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) and [Belinda](../character/belinda.md), where they share food, enjoy the echoes, and go off to pick early strawberries.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P37](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0037)_

> While picking strawberries for tea, [Belinda](../character/belinda.md) expresses concern to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) over Miss Rosalind's lingering melancholic mood and failing health. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) resolves to stay at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) during her vacation to help lift Miss Rosalind's spirits. Afterwards, the group enjoys tea outside, and [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) sits with Miss Rosalind as she opens up to him about her imaginary dream-boy.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051)_

> Following the end of the school term, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visits [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) and meets his father, [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md), who has unexpectedly arrived. [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) asks [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to inquire if he may visit [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), prompting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to deliver the request to a pale [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) and post the letter.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P20](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0020), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P39](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0039)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) prepares for Rosalind's wedding while discussing the romantic developments with [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md). Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) stumbles upon Isolde and [Gideon](../character/gideon-duckett.md) sharing an intimate moment in the garden, confirming their secret love. Isolde then visits [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to confide her engagement, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to reflect on love and her own romantic ideals.
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) discusses her upcoming wedding plans and guest list with Mrs. Sowerby and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md). Visitors arrive at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to celebrate, including [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), Mother [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), [Belinda](../character/belinda.md), [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), and [Reverend Ez](../character/ezra.md). After visiting Obed's grave in solitude, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) takes a walk and meets Hugh on the eve of their wedding.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P0](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P30](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P57](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0057)_

> On her wedding morning, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reflects warmly on her youth at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) while family and friends gather to prepare for the event. Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) are married by Mr. [Wace](../character/wace.md) in the sunlit orchard surrounded by loved ones. After a joyous celebration, the newlyweds leave for [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. [Agnes](../codex/places.md#agnes), leaving [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and the guests behind.
